description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-20. -->
## YouTube

- Open Quality beside Playback speed, choose a fixed resolution, or return to Auto. The timestamp still shows the resolution being played. Resize the center Play/Pause/Replay button and its touch target together.
- Hide feed view counts and upload age independently. Remove Shorts from the Quick Actions widget without removing the app-icon shortcut. Hide toolbar Messages without hiding Notifications, or hide the 2× Shorts tutorial without disabling the gesture, on versions that have it.
- Choose an opaque Android navigation bar separately for light and dark themes. Optionally disable swipe-up precise seeking without losing normal scrubbing.
- Dislike counts no longer block the watch page or feed while loading. SponsorBlock reuses segment lists for five minutes without reusing skip or undo state. The player avoids redundant seek-preview and label layout work, and component filters skip unnecessary encoding.
- Audio downloads that also save a thumbnail fetch the original artwork only once.

## YouTube Music

- Hide the native Search tab while retaining toolbar Search. On supported 9.x versions, hide **Don’t recommend artist** without hiding other artist actions.
- Hidden stock settings stay hidden when the app language changes. Both apps now avoid reapplying unchanged launcher icons and names at startup.

**Verification:** 71 focused tests passed. All four supported YouTube and six supported Music versions patched without force; forced Music 6.20.51 also passed. On the Moto, selecting 720p60 and then Auto restored adaptive mode without changing either saved network default. Messages, Shorts education, the artist row and watch-page vote labels were not served in the live fixtures. In both app themes the tested navigation strip looked identical with the opacity setting on or off; no visible difference was established.
